description: This Java source file defines the class EntityTagMatchers, which represents a collection of EntityTagMatcher objects. It provides methods to construct instances from comma-separated strings, lists, or arrays of EntityTagMatcher, and offers utility functions such as toString, stream, iterator, and equality checks. It is part of the package handling entity tag matching logic within the Eclipse Ditto project.
